new.title: Known result rebuilt, bounded integer matrices with constant margins decompose into layers of edge-disjoint permutations
new.statement:
∀ (n B D : ℕ),
  ∀ w : Fin n → Fin n → ℕ,
    (∀ i j, w i j ≤ B) →
    (∀ i, (∑ j, w i j) = B*D) →
    (∀ j, (∑ i, w i j) = B*D) →
    ∃ perm : Fin B → Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      (∀ layer i, Function.Injective (fun step => perm layer step i)) ∧
      ∀ i j, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin B × Fin D)).filter

new.unlocks: Decomposes the matrix of normalized witness counts into simple regular factors.
new.context: At B=0 every entry is zero and the layer index is empty. For B>0, divide every weight by B. new.title: One full row of errors is the sharp cost for an inequivalent Hadamard target at the minimum nonlinear budget
new.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true]))
∀ s : ℕ, 2 ≤ s →
  let N := 4^s
  let T := Fin N → Fin N → Bool
  let V := Fin (2*s) → ZMod 2
  let had := fun (H : T) => ∀ a b : Fin N, a ≠ b →
    2 * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun j => H a j ≠ H b j)).card = N
  let sylvester := fun (H : T) => ∃ (r c : Fin N ≃ V) (u v : Fin N → Bool),
    ∀ i j, H i j = xor (xor (u i) (v j)) (decide ((∑ b : Fin (2*s), r i b * c j b) = 1))
  let valid := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ s
  let errors := fun (H : T) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    ∑ i : Fin N, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun j =>
      H i j ≠ C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach i j))).card
  let dot := fun (i j : Fin N) => decide
    ((∑ b : Fin (2*s), if i.val.testBit b.val && j.val.testBit b.val then 1 else 0) % 2 = 1)
  let switched := fun (i j : Fin N) =>
    xor (dot i j) (decide (i.val < 4) && j.val.testBit 0 && j.val.testBit 1)
  (∀ H : T, had H → ¬ sylvester H → ∀ C, valid C → N ≤ errors H C) ∧
    had switched ∧ ¬ sylvester switched ∧
    (∃ C, valid C ∧ (∀ i j, C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach i j) = dot i j) ∧
      errors switched C = N)

new.title: One cross-name parity and local bits classify the common-key witness translations of two one-round cyclic tests
new.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h : ℕ), 5 ≤ h → h + 7 ≤ k →
  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k - h
  let turn := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) => word (site - (dist : I))
  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word (site - (dist : I)) + word site + word (site + (dist : I))
  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)
  let tested := fun site : I => lo ≤ site.val
  ∀ (rowConst colConst : W),
    let good := fun (u v key : W) =>
      let row := chi (mix 1 (turn 1 key + u)) + key + rowConst
      let col := chi (mix 2 (turn 3 key + v)) + turn 4 key + colConst
      ∀ site : I, tested site → row site = 0 ∧ col site = 0
    let lifts := fun (a b d : W) => ∀ u v key : W,
      good u v key ↔ good (u+a) (v+b) (key+d)
    let signature := fun (u v : W) =>
      let x := mix 1 u
      let y := mix 2 v
      ((fun j : Fin h => x ((lo+j.val : ℕ) : I)),
       (fun j : Fin (h-1) => if j.val = 0 then y 0 else y ((lo+1+j.val : ℕ) : I)),
       x 0 + y 1)
    Function.Surjective (fun nm : W × W => signature nm.1 nm.2) ∧
      ∀ u v u' v' : W,
        let num := Nat.card {offset : W // lifts (u'+u) (v'+v) offset}
        (signature u v = signature u' v' → num = 2^(lo-7)) ∧
        (signature u v ≠ signature u' v' → num = 0)

new.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit on 2h name parities returns the normalized one-round common-key count in at most 4096(h+1) gates
new.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h : ℕ), 5 ≤ h → h + 7 ≤ k →
  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k - h
  let turn := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) => word (site - (dist : I))
  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word (site - (dist : I)) + word site + word (site + (dist : I))
  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)
  let tested := fun site : I => lo ≤ site.val
  ∀ (rowConst colConst : W),
    let good := fun (u v key : W) =>
      let row := chi (mix 1 (turn 1 key + u)) + key + rowConst
      let col := chi (mix 2 (turn 3 key + v)) + turn 4 key + colConst
      ∀ site : I, tested site → row site = 0 ∧ col site = 0
    let signature := fun (u v : W) =>
      let x := mix 1 u
      let y := mix 2 v
      ((fun j : Fin h => x ((lo+j.val : ℕ) : I)),
       (fun j : Fin (h-1) => if j.val = 0 then y 0 else y ((lo+1+j.val : ℕ) : I)),
       x 0 + y 1)
    let count := fun (u v : W) => ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (good u v)).card
    let arity := 2*h
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (digit : Fin 5 → Fin (arity + C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack arity C ∧
      C.output < arity + C.size ∧ C.size ≤ 4096*(h+1) ∧
      ∀ u v : W,
        let sig := signature u v
        let input := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin h => decide (sig.1 i = 1))) ++
          (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (h-1) => decide (sig.2.1 j = 1))) ++ [decide (sig.2.2 = 1)]
        let answer := ∑ j : Fin 5,
          if (C.wires input).getD (digit j).val false then 2^j.val else 0
        (C.eval input = true ↔ ∃ key : W, good u v key) ∧
          answer ≤ 16 ∧ count u v = 2^(lo-7) * answer

new.title: Find a distance-six graph and normalized circuit violating the raw-wire count
new.statement:
¬ (∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  (∀ firstRow secondRow : Fin n, firstRow ≠ secondRow → 6 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun col => G firstRow col ≠ G secondRow col)).card) →
  (∀ firstCol secondCol : Fin m, firstCol ≠ secondCol → 6 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun row => G row firstCol ≠ G row secondCol)).card) →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  let gates := Finset.range C.size
  let gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C
  let reads := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C gates
  let neg := @Finset.filter ℕ (fun k => (gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)
    (fun k => Classical.propDecidable ((gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)) gates
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates,
    ((g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧

  let q := ((Finset.range (n + m)).filter (fun w => 0 < reads w)).card

new.title: Disjoint perfect matchings on the actual cyclic name graph account for every common-key multiplicity
new.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k] (h r : ℕ),
  let span := if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2
  let seed := if r = 1 then 4 else 6*r-5
  (r = 1 ∨ 4 ≤ r) → max 5 (r+3) ≤ h → h+span ≤ k →
  let I := ZMod k
  let W := I → ZMod 2
  let lo := k-h
  let turn := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) => word (site - (dist : I))
  let mix := fun (dist : ℕ) (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word (site - (dist : I)) + word site + word (site + (dist : I))
  let chi := fun (word : W) (site : I) =>
    word site + (1 + word (site+1)) * word (site+2)
  ∀ cr cc : ℕ → W,
    let rowTest := fun (u key : W) =>
      let out := (List.range r).foldl (fun acc t =>
        chi (mix 1 acc) + turn (2*t) key + cr (t+1)) (turn 1 key + u)
      ∀ i : I, lo ≤ i.val → out i = 0
    let colTest := fun (v key : W) =>
      let out := (List.range r).foldl (fun acc t =>
        chi (mix 2 acc) + turn (3*(t+1)+1) key + cc (t+1)) (turn 3 key + v)
      ∀ i : I, lo ≤ i.val → out i = 0
    let wt := fun (u v : W) => Nat.card {x : W // rowTest u x ∧ colTest v x}
    let layers := 2^seed
    let degree := 2^(lo+span-seed)
    ∃ perm : Fin layers → Fin degree → Equiv.Perm W,
      (∀ j u, Function.Injective (fun t => perm j t u)) ∧
      ∀ u v, wt u v = 2^(lo-span) *
        (Nat.card {p : Fin layers × Fin degree // perm p.1 p.2 u = v})

new.title: A pair of consecutive differential constraints lists the raw keys for a fixed cyclic schedule at any depth
new.statement:
∀ (k d s : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun (n : ℕ) => (⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (n : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x (ix (i.val+k-n%k))
  let mix := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    x i + x (ix (i.val+d)) + x (ix (i.val+k-d%k))
  let layer := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    mix x i + (1+mix x (ix (i.val+1)))*mix x (ix (i.val+2))
  let polar := fun (x y : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    mix x (ix (i.val+1))*mix y (ix (i.val+2)) + mix x (ix (i.val+2))*mix y (ix (i.val+1))
  ∀ (start : ℕ) (feed : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ → W) (shift : Fin s → W),
    let state := fun (sched : ℕ → W) (name key : W) (t : ℕ) =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => W) (rot start key + name) (fun j x => layer x + rot (feed j) key + sched j) t
    ∀ (r t : ℕ), t+2 ≤ r → ∀ (name : W) (path : ℕ → Fin s → W),
      let fits := fun (w : W) => ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ p,
        state c name (w+shift p) j - state c name w j = path j p
      let pool := fun (j : ℕ) => (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun x =>
        ∀ p, layer (x+path j p) - layer x + rot (feed j) (shift p) = path (j+1) p)
      let dimension := fun (j : ℕ) => Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F
        {x : W | ∀ p, polar x (path j p) = 0})
      let candidates := (pool t).biUnion (fun x => (pool (t+1)).image (fun y =>
        rot (k-(feed t)%k) (y-layer x-c t)))
      (Finset.univ.filter fits = candidates.filter fits) ∧
        candidates.card ≤ 2^(dimension t + dimension (t+1))

new.title: Two quadratic sums count three rounds of raw-key difference histories at prescribed names and constants
new.statement:
∀ (k d s : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k),

    x i + x (ix (i.val+d)) + x (ix (i.val+k-d%k))
  let layer := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    mix x i + (1+mix x (ix (i.val+1)))*mix x (ix (i.val+2))
  let polar := fun (x y : W) (i : Fin k) =>
    mix x (ix (i.val+1))*mix y (ix (i.val+2)) + mix x (ix (i.val+2))*mix y (ix (i.val+1))
  ∀ (start : ℕ) (feed : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ → W) (shift : Fin s → W),
    let state := fun (sched : ℕ → W) (name key : W) (t : ℕ) =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => W) (rot start key + name) (fun j x => layer x + rot (feed j) key + sched j) t
    ∀ (next later : Fin s → W),
      let A := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun x => ∀ p,
        layer (x+rot start (shift p)) - layer x + rot (feed 0) (shift p) = next p)
      let B := (Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun y => ∀ p,
        layer (y+next p) - layer y + rot (feed 1) (shift p) = later p)

      let pairs := (Finset.univ : Finset (W × W)).filter (fun nw => passes nw.1 nw.2)

        let price := fun z => dotProduct km (inv z) + dotProduct nm (rot start (inv z))

changed.title: Weighted cut-slot accounting for private trees in reduced fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuits
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let gates := Finset.range C.size
  let gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C
  let reads := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C gates
  let neg := @Finset.filter ℕ (fun k => (gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)
    (fun k => Classical.propDecidable ((gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)) gates
  let special := ((Finset.range (n + C.size)).filter (fun w => 2 ≤ reads w)) ∪
    neg.image (fun k => n + k)
  let ordinaryGates := gates.filter (fun k => n + k ∉ special)
  let used := (Finset.range n).filter (fun w => 0 < reads w)
  let multiple := (Finset.range n).filter (fun w => 2 ≤ reads w)
  let once := (Finset.range n).filter (fun w => reads w = 1)
  let excess := C.size-neg.card+1-used.card
  let tree := fun (S E : Finset ℕ) => ∃ (region : Finset ℕ) (root : ℕ),
    let wires := S ∪ region.image (fun k => n + k)
    let localReads := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C region
    region ⊆ ordinaryGates ∧ root ∈ wires ∧ localReads root = 0 ∧
    (∀ b ∈ E, b ∉ wires ∧ b < root ∧ localReads b = 1) ∧
    (∀ j ∈ region,
      ((gate j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
       (gate j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
      (gate j).inputs.length = 2 ∧ ∀ w ∈ (gate j).inputs, w ∈ wires ∨ w ∈ E) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ wires, w ≠ root → localReads w = 1 ∧ reads w = 1 ∧ C.output ≠ w)
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates,
    ((g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
      g.inputs.length = 2) ∨ (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)) →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C →
  0 < C.size → C.output + 1 = n + C.size →
  (∀ j < C.size, j + 1 < C.size → 0 < reads (n + j)) →
  ∀ (p c : ℕ) (H : Finset ℕ), 0 < p → H ⊆ Finset.range n →
    (∀ w < n, reads w = 0 → w ∈ H) →
    (∀ S : Finset ℕ, S ⊆ once → tree S ∅ → (S \ H).card ≤ p) →
    (∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (b : ℕ), S ⊆ once → tree S {b} → (S \ H).card ≤ c) →
    n + (2*p-1)*multiple.card ≤
